title: Waterfront Adventures
specs: Top of the line boats, jet skis, and paddleboards
Located at Carillon Point on Lake Washington in Kirkland, WA
Must be 21+ years old with valid driver's license to rent boats or jet skis
Must be 18+ years old to drive jet skis, with a 21+ year old renting and signing
Paddleboard renters must be 18+ or have parent/guardian if under 18
Major credit/debit card required for $2,500 damage deposit hold per equipment
All renters must complete safety education and sign liability waivers
includes: Safety walkthrough and operations training prior to rental
Approved life jackets (required to be worn, zipped and buckled)
Temporary WA state boater’s license provided on-site
gap: Exact rental durations and minimum rental times not stated
blurb: Guests rent boats, jet skis, or paddleboards to explore Lake Washington. Motorized rentals require a safety walkthrough and a damage deposit. Rentals include training and safety equipment.
extraNote: Damage deposit hold of $2,500 required on credit/debit card for motorized rentals · Cancellation full refund if made more than 7 days before rental; no refund within 7 days · Late return fees: $5/min for 1-10 min late, $10/min for 11-15 min late, double next rental price for 16+ min late · Rental credit given for weather deemed too dangerous by on-site manager · Reschedule flexibility option available for 10% of rental cost allowing reschedule up to 48 hours before rental · Rental hut located just down the stairs from the top of the roundabout near the hotel at Carillon Point, Kirkland, WA.
